opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

This case, the judgments of the District Court in which were entered December 15 ,and 26, 1924, is transferred to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit in accordance with the Act of September 14, 1922, c. 305, 42 Stat. 837, construed as effective as to these judgments by § 14 of the Act of February 13, 1925, c. 229, 43 Stat. 942. Heitler v. United States, 260 U. S. 438, 439, 440; Pothier v. Rodman, 261 U. S. 307, 312; Hoffman v. McClelland, 264 U. S. 552, 555.
